column1: # Kernel.NockEntry: Objective contract manifest. Written by `scripts/check-objective-proofs.sh proofs --pin`;
# a removed or changed row needs a line in scripts/gates/objective-contract-changes.txt.

column8: ∀ {bytes : List UInt8} {params : Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.Params}, Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.decodeParams bytes = Option.some params → Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.encodeParams params = bytes

∀ {outputs : List Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.OutputSlot} {xs : List Minidregg.Theory.Noun} {x : Minidregg.Theory.Noun}, x ∈ xs → Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.effectWrite outputs x = Option.none → ∀ (ys : List Minidregg.Theory.Eval.FieldWrite), Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.effectWrites outputs xs ≠ Except.ok ys

∀ {outputs : List Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.OutputSlot} {xs : List Minidregg.Theory.Noun} {ys : List Minidregg.Theory.Eval.FieldWrite}, Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.effectWrites outputs xs = Except.ok ys → ∀ x ∈ xs, ∃ y ∈ ys, Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.effectWrite outputs x = Option.some y

∀ (u : Minidregg.Theory.Noun) (event : ℕ) (wire cause : Minidregg.Theory.Noun), Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.eventOf (u.cell (Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.job event wire cause)) = Option.some (wire, cause)
List Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.SampleSlot → List Minidregg.Theory.Noun → List Minidregg.Theory.Noun → Option String

∀ {read read' : ℕ → String → Option ℤ} {slot : Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.SampleSlot} {slots : List Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.SampleSlot} {ns ns' : List Minidregg.Theory.Noun}, Minidregg.Kernel.NockProgramCell.sampleSlots read slots = Option.some ns → Minidregg.Kernel.NockProgramCell.sampleSlots read' slots = Option.some ns' → slot ∈ slots → read slot.target slot.slot ≠ read' slot.target slot.slot → (∀ s ∈ slots, s ≠ slot → read s.target s.slot = read' s.target s.slot) → Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.firstStale slots ns' ns = Option.some slot.key
∀ (items : List Minidregg.Theory.Noun), Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.listItems (Minidregg.Kernel.NockProgramCell.nockList items) = Option.some items

∀ {n : Minidregg.Theory.Noun} {value : ℤ}, Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.decodeValue Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.SlotType.noun n = Option.some value → value = Int.ofNat (Minidregg.Kernel.NockProgramCell.jamAtom n) ∧ n.jam.length ≤ Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.nounMaxBytes ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.NockProgramCell.encodeValue Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.SlotType.noun value = Option.some n
∀ {fuel : ℕ} {s f : Minidregg.Theory.Noun} {k : ℕ}, Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.oracle fuel s f = Minidregg.Theory.Eval.Ran.crash k → Minidregg.Theory.Nock.Crash s f

∀ {fuel : ℕ} {s f : Minidregg.Theory.Noun} {k : ℕ}, Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.oracle fuel s f = Minidregg.Theory.Eval.Ran.exhausted k → Minidregg.Theory.Nock.run fuel s f = Except.error Minidregg.Theory.Eval.Outcome.exhausted ∧ k = fuel

∀ (fuel : ℕ) (s f : Minidregg.Theory.Noun), Minidregg.Theory.Nock.runJammed fuel (s.cell f).jam = match Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.oracle fuel s f with | Minidregg.Theory.Eval.Ran.ok v k => Minidregg.Theory.Eval.ByteRun.ok k v.jam | Minidregg.Theory.Eval.Ran.crash k => Minidregg.Theory.Eval.ByteRun.crash k | Minidregg.Theory.Eval.Ran.exhausted k => Minidregg.Theory.Eval.ByteRun.exhausted k

∀ {fuel : ℕ} {s f v : Minidregg.Theory.Noun} {k : ℕ}, Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.oracle fuel s f = Minidregg.Theory.Eval.Ran.ok v k → Minidregg.Theory.Nock.Step s f v ∧ Minidregg.Theory.Nock.run fuel s f = Except.ok v ∧ Minidregg.Theory.Nock.steps fuel s f = k

∀ {product door effects state : Minidregg.Theory.Noun}, Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.pokeProduct product = Option.some (door, effects, state) → ∃ core, product = door.cell (effects.cell core) ∧ Minidregg.Theory.Noun.axis 6 core = Option.some state ∧ Minidregg.Theory.Noun.edit 6 state door = Option.some core
Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.Abi → Minidregg.Theory.Noun → List UInt8 → Option String

∀ {abi : Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.Abi} {ctx ctx' : Minidregg.Kernel.NockProgramCell.Context} {targets : List ℕ} {read read' : ℕ → String → Option ℤ} {sample sample' : Minidregg.Theory.Noun} {slot : Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.SampleSlot}, abi.context = Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.ContextMode.pinned → Minidregg.Kernel.NockProgramCell.sampleOf abi ctx targets read = Option.some sample → Minidregg.Kernel.NockProgramCell.sampleOf abi ctx' targets read' = Option.some sample' → slot ∈ abi.sample → read slot.target slot.slot ≠ read' slot.target slot.slot → (∀ s ∈ abi.sample, s ≠ slot → read s.target s.slot = read' s.target s.slot) → sample ≠ sample' ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.staleField abi sample' sample.jam = Option.some slot.key
ℕ → Minidregg.Theory.Noun → List Minidregg.Theory.Noun → Minidregg.Theory.Noun → Minidregg.Theory.Noun × Minidregg.Theory.Noun
∀ {a b : Option Minidregg.Theory.Noun}, Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.ustateNoun a = Minidregg.Kernel.NockEntry.ustateNoun b → a = b
